title: Lobster Ascension
description: A vibrant stained-glass style artwork depicts a large red lobster floating centrally, surrounded by green leaves and a glowing aura. Below, a crowd of people in a forest clearing look upward, one woman holding a glowing lightbulb, while a dog stands beside her; above the lobster, four fairies fly around a bright orange sun against a blue sky.
prompt: Stained glass window artwork featuring a giant detailed red lobster floating in the center, wrapped in green vines, with a glowing aura. Four small fairies fly around a bright orange sun in a blue sky at the top. Below in a dark forest clearing, a diverse crowd of people reach upwards in awe, a woman in green kneels holding a glowing lightbulb, a spotted dog stands nearby, and large colorful mushrooms grow on the right side. Intricate lead lines, rich jewel tones, mystical and surreal atmosphere.
